bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; transferring renewable development account funds to the preweatherization account.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+TRANSFER TO THE PREWEATHERIZATION ACCOUNT. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $4,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is transferred from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the preweatherization account under Minnesota Statutes, section 216C.264, subdivision 1c. This is a onetime transfer. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; transferring renewable development account funds to the preweatherization account.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. TRANSFER TO THE PREWEATHERIZATION ACCOUNT.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $4,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is transferred from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the preweatherization account under Minnesota Statutes, section 216C.264, subdivision 1c. This is a onetime transfer.
additions: Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $4,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is transferred from the renewable development account under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the preweatherization account under Minnesota Statutes, section 216C.264, subdivision 1c. This is a onetime transfer.
